questions.prompt: When does an exercise section unlock the next section?
choices: When you click the Mark as done button
When the code compiles without a single warning
When you open the sample solution
questions.explanation: Exercises gate on checks: regexes graded against each pane's output; when all pass, the section is marked done automatically.

questions.prompt: How do the two playground panes run relative to each other?
choices: Pane B only runs after pane A exits
One shared process, split into two windows
Fully independently, one process per pane
Pane A is only the editor; pane B runs the code
questions.explanation: Each pane has its own WebSocket and process — which is exactly why a client/server pair can talk over localhost.
